variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders the verb causatively with a personal object, "drove out the Amorites that were there", which is the hiphil sense of the qere וַיּוֹרֶשׁ (dispossess/drive out). The ketiv ויירש, with its doubled yod, points to the qal wayyiras, which ASV elsewhere gives as "possessed"; "drove out" is not that verb's rendering. No ASV note is mapped to this unit, but the wording alone distinguishes the reading.
